run_unconditional_sampling: run unconditional diffusion model sampling to generate images using DDIM or vanilla DDPM
load_model_from_config: load a diffusion model from a config and state dict checkpoint onto GPU
make_convolutional_sample: generate a batch of samples from a diffusion model with DDIM or vanilla sampling
custom_to_pil: convert a PyTorch tensor to a PIL Image by clamping, rescaling, and permuting dimensions
convsample_ddim: sample from a diffusion model using DDIM with a specified number of steps and eta
